projects.name: Rock Investment Outlook 2026
projects.description: Co-developed with Edward Chege Waweru for the Rock Investment Bank Research Challenge 2026. This completed research examines Kenya’s banking, telecommunications and manufacturing sectors, bringing together market performance, macroeconomic conditions, fixed-income evidence, risk analysis and conditional 12-month scenarios. The companion Streamlit platform makes the research easier to explore. The remaining step is to showcase the completed work on LinkedIn.
